decision_conditions: The works approved by this Listed Building Consent must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this decision noticeReason: To comply with S.51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the approved plans as set out in the attached schedule which forms part of this notice.6031/016031/026031/036031/04300/CHA/100300/CHA/110300/CHA/120300/CHA/130300/CHA/131300/CHA/132Heritage StatementSuds ProformaReason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning

Prior to their installation, large-scale drawings of all new windows and doors shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The drawings shall be provided at a scale of between 1:1 and 1:20 and shall include elevations and sections, together with full details of the new door cill, including its materials, profile, and finish. The works shall thereafter be carried out in full accordance with the approved details and permanently maintained as such.Reason: In order to safeguard the special architectural and historic interest of the building.

All repair works to address water ingress, together with any associated making good, shall match the existing original fabric in terms of materials, construction, profile, colour, finish, and workmanship. Prior to the commencement of any repair works, a detailed schedule of works and a methodology statement shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The works shall be carried out strictly in accordance with the approved details.Reason: In order to safeguard the special architectural and historic interest of the building.

Prior to above ground works the works involving the construction of the new extension, sample panels measuring a minimum of 1 square metre shall be erected on site and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The sample panels shall demonstrate the proposed brick size, colour, texture, and bond, together with mortar mix, joint size, colour, and pointing profile. Once approved, the sample panels shall be retained on site for reference for the duration of the works unless otherwise agreed in writing by the local planning authority. The development shall be carried out in full accordance with the approved details and permanently maintained as such.Reason: In order to safeguard the special architectural and historic interest of the building.

The rear wall located outside the footprint of the existing rear extension shall not be removed or altered unless otherwise agreed in writing by the local planning authority. Any approved demolition works shall be carried out by hand or using hand-held tools only, and shall not involve the use of power-driven tools.Reason: In order to safeguard the special architectural and historic interest of the building.
description: Internal repair and refurbishment works, extension to the rear of the existing rear extension with replacement windows and door.
